en: That's Emiliana Arango
into the second round in Cincinnati
for the first time in her career, taking
on one of the true greats of the sport.
Venus Williams not able to find the kind
of level she'd have liked today, but you
have to give all credit to the Colombian
who did exactly what she needed to do.
A real clarity around her game plan
and an impressive execution of it.
Emiliana, congratulations.
We are all so curious to know what
that experience was like.
She won her first Grand Slam title
a few months before you were born
I mean, so to play a legend like
that has to be pretty special for you.
Definitely. It felt so surreal like
when the draw came out and I saw it,
I was like, "Oh man.", it's so exciting
to get to have this opportunity.
I mean, growing up, I always saw her on TV
and now getting to play her is is really crazy.
What were you focusing on?
I mean, there's so much to it emotionally,
but as far as your game,
you looked so strong out here.
What were you paying the most attention
to in terms of your plan?
Honestly, my legs.
I like my coach told me,
I do not want to see you moving slow.
The only thing I want is for legs to go
for your legs to go fast.
So, I tried to focus as much
as I could on that.
Try to get as many balls back as I could.
And I I think I did a good job of it.
We love having you here in Cincinnati.
You have such an incredible story.
We know you're a family girl.
Your family invested in your career.
I mean, and you are here now
so proud playing some of the best tennis
of your life.
What have you enjoyed here
in Cincinnati outside of tennis?
Maybe.
Definitely the golf.
I've been well my coach loves the golf
and the tournament does such a great job
of like letting us play
and giving us some clubs
and so my coach was out there.
He's like let's go play some golf.
The thing is he's really good and I
am not that good so it really pisses me off.
All right, last quick question for you.
We love the trademark backwards hat.
What started this tradition?
It's pretty cool.
Honestly, my mom I my when I
was younger, my hair wouldn't grow
and I would like always have it down
and I would put on the hat.
But then my coach, which is funny enough,
same coach I have here, he was like,
"Nobody plays like that.
You got to put your hair up in a bun
or like in a ponytail.
Do something with your hair." And
so my mom was like,
"Why don't you braid it?" And
so she would braid it.
And then I was like, "Okay, and what
do I do with my hat?" And she goes,
"Why don't you just put it backwards?" So,
I mean, I was 10 years old and I've kept it
since.
Now, I don't think I can take it back.
Come on, everyone.
Impossible not to love her.
That is Emiliana Arango.
